key_facts: The document concerns the 2026 Mexico City Grand Prix on 30 October – 1 November 2026.
It sets out instructions for all teams and officials on qualifying, pit procedures, safety car deployment, and track limits.
Drivers who exceed a maximum time between safety car lines during qualifying or reconnaissance laps may be penalised for going unnecessarily slowly.
Drivers being lapped must allow the faster driver past at the first available opportunity once blue light panels are shown.
The document specifies where and how practice starts may be performed during free practice and reconnaissance laps, but not during qualifying.
plain_explanation:
This document is the Race Director's Competition Notes for the 2026 Mexico City Grand Prix, issued on 1 November 2026. It contains instructions for teams and officials on how to conduct the event safely and fairly.

During qualifying and reconnaissance laps, drivers must not exceed a maximum time between the Second Safety Car Line and the First Safety Car Line. Teams will be told what this time is after the second practice session. A driver who goes over this time may be penalised for going unnecessarily slowly. This rule applies to all laps during and after qualifying, including in-laps and out-laps, and to reconnaissance laps when the pit exit is opened before the race.

When a faster driver is catching a slower car during the race, the marshalling system will first send a pre-warning message when the faster car is within 3 seconds. When the faster car gets within 1.2 seconds, blue light panels will be shown to the slower car, along with blue cockpit lights and a message on the timing monitors. At this point the slower driver must let the faster driver overtake at the first opportunity. The rule requires this under the International Sporting Code (ISC), which says drivers who are caught by another car must allow the faster driver past.

Practice starts are allowed in special painted grid boxes during free practice sessions and during reconnaissance laps before the race. During free practice, practice starts may be performed in the merging lane to the right-hand side of the fast lane. During reconnaissance laps, cars wishing to do a practice start must use the pit exit road and may stop in the area before Safety Car Line 2. They must then rejoin from the pit exit road. Practice starts are not allowed during the qualifying session.

If qualifying is interrupted with less than 75 seconds remaining in any period, that period will not be resumed.

The Safety Car will not be signalled by waved yellow flags or "SC" boards. Instead, when the Safety Car is deployed, the message "SAFETY CAR DEPLOYED" will be sent to all teams and all trackside light panels will display "SC". When the Safety Car lights are turned off, the message "SAFETY CAR LIGHTS OFF" will be sent to all teams, and a green light panel will show at the control line.

The document also sets out rules for pit entry and pit exit, parc fermé access, removal of cars from the grid, track limits at specific turns, and changes made to the circuit for this event.
